audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Howling Gale as matchup-defining but has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad lines pasted under unrelated titles. report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Janna as 'his' — she is she/her per champ-gender.js.
audit.why: Real numbers make the cooldown claim usable: Howling Gale (Q) is a 14s-cooldown charge-up storm, and Zyra's R is 110/100/90s. Janna is on the confirmed female roster.
Level chart is Zyra-favoured all seven rows, matching packet.levelChart (all 'Zyra') and win[N] already agrees with phases[N].side.

Spikes correctly flag level 2 (E-root kill window before Janna's Q is usually charged), level 6 (Stranglethorns forces Monsoon defensively), and 1st item/late as free-poke windows against a damage-less enchanter. Grounded in real kit.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Stranglethorns banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Janna's Howling Gale (Q) needs 14 seconds to fully charge — an uncharged storm can't peel, so hit her before it caps. Your R Stranglethorns runs 110/100/90s; bank it and only spend it on the fight that actually decides the game.

edits.before: Seed, Q the pair, root the answer — the trade was 4v2 and the floor did the arguing.
edits.after: Root through her Q charge window — an uncharged Howling Gale can't peel the plant DPS.

edits.before: Trading gardenless like an honest mage — the plants ARE the champion; the spells are gardening tools.
edits.after: Never all-in while she still has a charged E — Eye of the Storm shields the AD spike hard enough to flip it.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
